_comment: Golden table for the learning logic (correction to rule, rule edits, stats, export, import). The expected values were produced by running the JS (src/services/learningService.js, ruleExporter.js) under vitest with Date frozen at each step's `now` and a daemonCall mock that stores feedback the way learning.load/learning.save round-trip it (stats keep only the snake_case fields). `initial` and `after` are the stored feedback. Consumed by src-core/src/learning.rs via include_str!.

scenarios.name: corrections make domain, subject and address rules
sender strings that make no rule or an odd domain
subject words: separators, ties and no shared word

previewCases.name: valid file keeps typed, patterned rules
array version compares as its text

params.e: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 (line 1 column 2)
